learning-vision.title: Vision & Core Curriculum
learning-vision.intro: Hanbit explores the world through the lens of science, with a continuous STEM journey from preschool to secondary.

sections.b: Every lesson starts with a question. Children observe, hypothesise and experiment, building the foundations of scientific thinking.
Following the engineering design process, students define, design, build and improve — turning learning into real-world capability.
Primary and secondary combine with the Cambridge curriculum for a world-recognised learning path.

learning-preschool.title: Preschool & Kindergarten Curriculum
learning-preschool.intro: English and science foundations grow alongside social, emotional and intellectual development.

sections.b: Motivation, scientific curiosity, literacy, physical rhythm, English, and social-emotional growth, built step by step.
A continuous path from Pre1 (Newton) through K1 (Da Vinci), K2 (Darwin) and Y1 (Einstein).

learning-primary.title: Primary Curriculum
learning-primary.intro: A robust, world-class education combining our STEM programme with the Cambridge curriculum.

sections.b: Subject specialists lead deep learning in small classes.
Students build and explore in modern labs and workshops.

learning-secondary.title: Secondary Curriculum
learning-secondary.intro: University and start-up links nurture innovation and entrepreneurship, leading into Cambridge IGCSE.

sections.b: Real-world projects and mentorship build self-directed capability.
A world-recognised qualification that lays the foundation for higher study.

learning-igcse.title: IGCSE & A-Level
learning-igcse.intro: The Cambridge international curriculum, from core and elective subjects through to advanced A-Level.

sections.b: English, mathematics and the sciences (physics, chemistry, biology) form a strong academic base.
Advanced subject choices build expertise aligned to university and career goals.

about-founders.title: Founder's Message
about-founders.intro: Hanbit honors each child's curiosity, raising future innovators who contribute to a better society.

sections.b: We raise children who understand the world through science, think for themselves, and collaborate.
We build a safe, warm place to learn that every family can trust.

about-history.title: History & Milestones
about-history.intro: From our start in Seoul in 2016 to five cities nationwide — ten years of Hanbit.

sections.b: From our first preschool campus to primary and secondary programmes, the Cambridge curriculum, and nationwide expansion.
Onward to five city campuses and our secondary & A-Level pathway.

enrichment-afterschool.title: Afterschool Programs
enrichment-afterschool.intro: A range of afterschool programmes for Hanbit and non-Hanbit students alike.

sections.b: Ballet, dance, art, music/piano and PE develop expression and physical growth.
STEM Academy, science and digital creative build thinking and creativity.

enrichment-saturday.title: Saturday School
enrichment-saturday.intro: Learning continues on weekends, with programmes for preschool, kindergarten and primary.

sections.b: Play- and inquiry-based activities make learning joyful.
Level-based classes focus on English and science.

enrichment-mother-toddler.title: Mother & Toddler Program
enrichment-mother-toddler.intro: A first taste of learning — a programme for infants and parents together.

sections.b: Sensory play and interaction nurture emotional security and curiosity.
